pages.text: Works as a room or as open ground. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Mining speed, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)4 of any ores$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)any ores$(li)any rails$(li)Ladder$(li)any storage blocks$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: A room of this kind can be one of two things, and which one is decided by what you put in it - not by choosing.$(p)Either way it scores the same and is worth the same. What changes is which gift it gives, never how large.
pages.title: What it is for

pages.text: The usual reading of the room. Grants:$(li)Mining speed, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)any rails$(li)Ladder$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)
pages.title: Shaft

pages.text: Grants instead:$(li)Bonus drops, growing with the tier, up to +12%%.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)any storage blocks$(li)any ores
pages.title: Vein

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Rails runs in a line of at least 4, best at 12, and supports runs along rails, and ores is within 3 of rails.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Rails: any rails$(li)Supports: Ladder$(li)Ores: any ores
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: Worth more for standing near the right neighbours - never required, only rewarded:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/workshop)Workshop$(/l), built beneath it, with at most 6 blocks between
pages.title: Rooms that go together
